items.title: Blackstone president calls for more equity to fund AI buildout as debt risks mount
items.summary: The artificial intelligence infrastructure buildout will need more equity financing as lenders become increasingly exposed to the companies driving the buildout, Blackstone President Jon Gray said Tuesday.

items.title: Texas governor race tightens in prediction markets, but Abbott remains favored
items.summary: Political observers are watching the Texas gubernatorial election for signs of an artificial intelligence data center backlash in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday, and prediction market traders see growing odds of the Democratic candidate pulling off an upset.

items.title: Stock market after midterm elections: What S&P 500 history shows
items.summary: Markets are sweating it out ahead of the midterm elections , but the event historically heralds strong performance for stocks — regardless of whether it's a red or blue wave , split decision, or status quo in Washington.

items.title: Job openings posted big September gain in positive sign for labor market ahead of payrolls report
items.summary: Job openings surged in September, as did the number of workers who quit their positions, the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported Tuesday, while hiring also rose and layoffs dropped.

items.title: Australia hikes rates to 18-year high to fight inflation
items.summary: Australia's central bank raised its benchmark cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.85% on Tuesday, the highest level since November 2008.
